The Vale: Shadow of the Crown will be 40% off this week in celebration of its 6 nominations across 3 Canadian awards shows.

Starting Tuesday April 5th The Vale is up for “best video game narrative” at the 10th Canadian Screen Awards.

Then on Thursday April 7th we are up for “best PC game”, “best audio design”, “best game design” and “best technology /innovation” at  the Canadian Indie Game Awards.

Finally, on Friday April 8th the game is up for “best audio design” again at the main Canadian Game Awards show.

Pick up the game if you haven't already, and check out the best in Canadian games and media.

notes.title: Steam Awards Voting Begins!
notes.notes:
The narrative of The Vale: Shadow of the Crown is bold, innovative, and detailed. The story is packed with emotional plot twists, gripping scenes of intense action, and meaningful emotional stakes. The performances by top-tier voice actors are bolstered by cinematic audio. The focus and intimacy of the dialogue and soundscapes are heightened by the lack of the visuals, culminating in a sense of unique immersion that has seldom been experienced in video games. 

So please, cast your vote for The Vale for Outstanding Story-Rich Game.

notes.title: Launch Day
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34979254/9c101bad5a3c119e2149ae87877e1a723b442933.png[/img]
Today, Falling Squirrel's award-winning, audio-only action-adventure game The Vale: Shadow of the Crown launches on PC (Steam, itch.io, and Epic Games) and Xbox One!

We have so many people to thank! The CNIB , Ontario Creates,  Creative Bytes Studios,  Microsoft, Ubisoft , the community at AudioGames.net , all of our testers and fans, our friends and family, and all of the talented developers, musicians, actors, designers, artists, and many more who helped make The Vale possible! Thank you!

But that’s enough from me- go put on your headphones, grab a controller, and play through a gaming experience that’s unlike anything you’ve played before! 

Want to know more about The Vale: Shadow of the Crown  -  view our full launch announcement here: 
 https://www.fallingsquirrel.com/blog

notes.title: The Vale: Shadow of the Crown will Launch August 19!
notes.notes: We're finally here! After years of development and months of Covid delays, The Vale will be releasing this August 19th. Our very small core team is forever grateful for the hundreds of helping hands we've received along the way from the indie dev and blind communities!  Thank you!

notes.title: Audio-only RPG The Vale launches its accessible adventure in August
notes.notes:
Hear that? It's the approaching release date for audio-only action adventure The Vale. The accessible adventure about a blind princess challenges you to combat driven by audio cues and haptic feedback. Developers Falling Squirrel have announced that you'll be able to tackle the adventure yourself next month, although you can also take it for a spin right now in a demo.

notes.title: The Vale Update
notes.notes:
We’ve been hard at work finishing The Vale, and it’s been a while since our last update. 

At this time, The Vale is approaching the Gold Master milestone — which is the point where the game is submitted to platforms for certification and bug testing before being made available for purchase. However, we’re currently unable to complete work on voice over for the game's final chapter. As the health and safety of everyone involved is our top priority, we made the difficult decision to pause recording until Toronto is out of lockdown.  Without a clear idea of when this might happen, it is challenging for us to predict a firm launch date for The Vale. As soon as lockdown is lifted, however,  and voice over recording can resume, we will be able to announce our new release date. 

More than anything, we truly appreciate the support and patience shown to us during this uncertain time. In return, we pledge to deliver The Vale to its followers as quickly as is safely possible, while meeting the high standards we have set for the game since its inception.

We’ll be checking in every week or two on social media, and will keep you posted on any changes. In the meantime, have some plans to start developer streams and hope you will join us for a deeper look at The Vale.

Again,  thank you for your continued support for The Vale - we can’t wait to release it to you.
